QUOTE: The args string comes from `args_to_pattern` (server_manager.cpp:426): it is the value of the first JSON key if that value is a string, otherwise `*`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States only one argument value (the first key's string) reaches the pattern and non-string collapses to `*`; the second surprise notes other args are missed, covering the invisibility of the rest.
